map.坐位体前屈测试方法：受试者坐在平地上，双腿伸直脚跟触挡板，上体前屈用指尖推动游标: Seated forward reach test method: the subject sits on a flat surface with legs straight and heels against the board, leans forward and pushes the cursor with fingertips, and the maximum reach distance is recorded (cm; a negative value means the fingertips did not reach the toes).
map.测试前应充分热身，避免拉伤；膝关节不得弯曲；双手应匀速前推，不得有突然发力: Warm up fully before the test to avoid strain; the knees must not bend; push forward at a steady speed with no sudden force.
map.百分等级表示在同年龄同性别人群中超过的百分比，如 P75 表示优于 75% 的人: Percentile rank is the percentage of people in the same age and gender group that you exceed, e.g. P75 means better than 75% of people.
map.本工具数据为参考标准，实际评级以当地体育部门标准为准: Data in this tool is a reference standard; actual grading follows the standards of your local sports authority.
